images.title: Alternate the signs from the units digit
images.purpose: Shows the test for 11 on 5529: +9 − 2 + 5 − 5 = 7, so the remainder is 7.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One number with small signs under its digits, and one line below.
images.exact_structure: The number 5529 in four large boxes. Under each box, a small sign, from the right: + under 9, − under 2, + under 5, − under the first 5; plus signs teal (#0072B2), minus signs amber (#E69F00). One arrow at the right points left to show the start at the units digit. Below, the line +9 − 2 + 5 − 5 = 7, and a reddish purple (#CC79A7) tag remainder 7. Nothing else in the frame.
